body:
Independent two-pass review (contract-and-integration and counterexample-and-saturation) completed on head commit a3edab7ea0f5ead44503dd72410f2e0943374c52 against base af264ec854a4bf47868f6f7bc4193a4ba979e2c7 across all 17 changed files.

Scope and behavioral verification:
- Normalizes epoch-millisecond clock generation across operational and launcher scripts by introducing the portable epoch_millis helper in net-deployment-runbook/04-ops/epoch-millis.sh and net-deployment-runbook/scripts/epoch-millis.sh.
- Eliminates non-portable date +%s%3N invocations that caused 9-digit nanosecond width expansion, multi-million latency_ms metrics, and miscalculated request deadlines.
- Replaces raw clock reads in gateway deadlines, elapsed latency math, completion receipts, readiness polling, and canary cache busters.
- Strengthens public traffic-readiness verification in net-deployment-runbook/04-ops/wait-public-traffic-readiness.sh to reject pre-verification completions, unordered lifecycle heights, and future nanosecond-scale completion timestamps before accepting fresh millisecond receipts.
- Updates public observability schemas in net-deployment-runbook/scripts/capture-gateway-observability.sh and net-deployment-runbook/scripts/verify-public-homepage.sh to bound latency_ms to [0, 60000] and require valid 13-digit completion timestamps when non-zero.
- Maintains dual-tree installation parity in net-deployment-runbook/04-ops/install-ops.sh without cross-tree runtime dependencies.

Authoritative verification and test results:
- GONKA_UPSTREAM_WORKTREE bound to sealed Gonka source: make -C net-deployment-runbook test passed (all unit, integration, and contract suites green).
- Full repository shellcheck passed (make -C net-deployment-runbook shellcheck).
- Focused regression tests passed:
  - net-deployment-runbook/scripts/test-epoch-millis.sh (reproduces %3N expansion, verifies 16 ms elapsed math, tests BSD %N fallback, checks file parity, and confirms absence of date +%s%3N across all operational scripts).
  - net-deployment-runbook/scripts/test-public-traffic-readiness.sh (falsification sequence testing stale timestamps, old completions, nanosecond future completions, unordered heights, and acceptance on fresh ordered receipt).
  - net-deployment-runbook/scripts/test-gateway-health-probe.sh (enforces latency_ms bounds [0, 60000] and 13-digit completion timestamp regex).
  - net-deployment-runbook/scripts/test-profiles.sh (verifies installation targets and absence of unnormalized clocks).

Both reviewer passes converged with 0 blocking findings and all 7 risk dimensions verified. Falsification challenges across timebase normalization, receipt acceptance boundaries, schema validation, and installation parity confirmed.

<!-- ever-guild-review:b04250f0a2b6fb140837d01f75e5f0d96f27217330701dc7757ce545b8a353fc -->

Two independent static review passes covered all 17 changed files and reconciled the existing discussion. Both reports passed coverage validation. No verified PR-introduced blocking defect was found. Additional tracing covered millisecond deadlines through the admission proxy, stale/future receipt rejection, and helper installation beside both systemd consumers.

Verification remains incomplete in this invocation. git diff --check passed, but make -C net-deployment-runbook test never started: the credential-isolated runner could not create its bwrap namespace. The exact-head Net deployment runbook CI run currently reports action_required, so it supplies no passing contract or ShellCheck result. The earlier approval on this unchanged head reports successful tests; those results were not independently reproduced here.

COMMENT records this verification limitation. Complete the required CI checks on this head before treating this re-review as merge-readiness evidence. Live deployment and canary acceptance remain separate operational checks and were not performed.

<!-- ever-guild-review:3e08aa940bcc9b26e83e8c385827d6845ef56facca06dadc4bf796756114126b -->

It fixes the millisecond calculation and timestamp checks but does not implement the public inference acceptance, the deployment and qualification of DevShard v5, or the separate migration to Gonka v0.2.16 while preserving network state, all of which are required by issue #49
